title: Android — design polish, Profile → Details, hold-to-record voice, friend-accept fix
summary: More of the Android Figma pass plus a few fixes. The status bar now matches the toolbar (no more off-brand green), the bottom-nav icons are the new outlined set, photos and videos in chats are sized to hug the image instead of filling the row, and chats show the exact light/dark doodle wallpaper from the design. Profile gains a Details screen with an app lock (passcode + lock timeout), change password and delete profile. Voice messages switch to iOS-style hold-to-record — hold the mic to record, release to send, slide left to cancel — with a redesigned recording bar. The header theme toggle is gone (the Settings switch stays) and switching themes is now fast and smooth. Fixes a bug where messaging a contact who had just accepted your request was blocked with 'waiting for friend request'.

changes.title: Android — Profile → Details (app lock, change password, delete profile)
changes.description: A new Details screen under Profile: turn on an app lock that asks for your password when you reopen the app (with a lock-timeout option), change your password, or permanently delete the profile and all its data from the device.

changes.title: Android — messaging a freshly-accepted contact no longer blocked
changes.description: After you added someone and they accepted on their device, typing in the chat could still say 'Waiting for friend request to be accepted'. Messages now send and are delivered once the contact connects, instead of being blocked.

changes.title: Android — hold-to-record voice messages
changes.description: Voice messages now work like on iOS: press and hold the microphone to record, release to send, and slide left to cancel. The recording bar was restyled to match — timer, a blinking record dot and a large microphone button.

changes.title: Android — photos and videos sized to fit
changes.description: Media in chats no longer stretches across the whole row. Photos and videos now hug the image at a sensible size with rounded corners, keeping their aspect ratio, in both direct and group chats.

changes.title: Android — faster, smoother theme switching
changes.description: The sun/moon toggle was removed from the header (the dark-theme switch in Settings is enough), and switching between light and dark is now noticeably faster — it was rebuilding the screen twice.

changes.title: Android — design polish
changes.description: The system status bar now matches the toolbar instead of showing an off-brand green, the bottom navigation uses the new outlined icons, chats show the exact light/dark doodle wallpaper from the design, the profile MyID is shown as plain text, and the contact picker rows use clean letter avatars with an online/offline label.

changes.title: Android — cleaner media picker and import screen
changes.description: Picking a photo or video now opens the modern system photo picker (or a media-only picker on older devices) without the file-manager tabs, and the import-profile screen now describes the Android file-picker flow instead of the iOS one.
